60+.feet_apart: Gently bring your feet together when you feel comfortable.
60+.head_dropped: Softly raise your head and look ahead of you.
60+.spine_rounded: Take a breath in and slowly sit a little taller — no rush.
60+.knees_too_high: Take your time — breathe out and let your knees slowly relax.
60+.shoulders_raised: Gently let your shoulders melt down. You are doing well.

18-25.feet_apart: Bring the soles of your feet together — press them firmly.
18-25.head_dropped: Lift your chin — keep your gaze forward.
18-25.spine_rounded: Sit tall — lengthen your spine and lift your chest.
18-25.knees_too_high: Relax your hips and let your knees drop lower.
18-25.shoulders_raised: Drop your shoulders away from your ears. Relax your upper body.

26-40.feet_apart: Bring the soles of your feet together — press them firmly.
26-40.head_dropped: Lift your chin — keep your gaze forward.
26-40.spine_rounded: Sit tall — lengthen your spine and lift your chest.
26-40.knees_too_high: Relax your hips and let your knees drop lower.
26-40.shoulders_raised: Drop your shoulders away from your ears. Relax your upper body.

41-60.feet_apart: Try to bring your feet a little closer together.
41-60.head_dropped: Gently bring your chin level with the floor.
41-60.spine_rounded: Gently lift through the crown of your head and straighten your back.
41-60.knees_too_high: Gently allow your knees to soften downward toward the floor.
41-60.shoulders_raised: Soften your shoulders downward and breathe out.
